## What this evidence does and does not prove

  proves:
    - the staged Win64 package starts from the packaged executable, mounts the PICOOpenXR
      plugin and registers all 7 of its IOpenXRExtensionPlugins;
    - it loads the test map and reaches the game loop, with the plugin C++ actors
      (CameraPreview / eye-tracking debug) executing BeginPlay and then ticking;
    - it stays alive and consumes CPU for the whole sampling window, with no fatal
      error, assertion, ensure failure or LogOutputDevice error;
    - it shuts down through the normal viewport-closed path with exit code 0.
  does not prove:
    - that a PC OpenXR session was established. This build machine has no working PC
      OpenXR runtime; the loader reports XR_ERROR_VALIDATION_FAILURE, the extension
      list above comes from the plugin side, and every XR_PICO_* extension reports
      "not available". The full OpenXR session evidence is the Android capture.

## Verdict
PASS
  - the packaged exe mounted PICOOpenXR and registered 7 IOpenXRExtensionPlugins.
  - 5 CameraPreview lines and 51 eye-tracking tick lines from plugin actors.
  - process alive through the whole 60 s window, CPU time grew to 198.44 s.
  - graceful shutdown via WM_CLOSE, exit code 0.
  - every plugin-failure signature above is 0.
